title: Heuristics in risky decision-making relate to preferential representation of information
goal: Reproduce the original probability- and reward-prioritization relationships between localizer-trained MEG reactivation during choice and participants' behavioral heuristic weights, using the source-defined cohort, complete required maps, behavioral fits, identity joins and indispensable controls. Preserve localizer decoding as supporting empirical validation and any improvement in that decoder as a separately named method result; improved accuracy alone cannot establish primary reproduction or improvement. Keep the separate perceptual-detection and BIS findings as additional original empirical results, not automatic primary completion requirements.
primary_outputs: Reproduction: executable analysis and source-native outputs for the corrected primary empirical findings: Original Figures 4–5 localizer-to-choice probability/reward reactivation–heuristic-weight relationship, with the source behavioral-weight and decoder-validation companions necessary to that claim; no every-figure requirement. Exact numerical panel binding remains unresolved.
Primary improvement: unavailable until a source-grounded same-result comparison is independently justified; no new score or direction is implied.

Retained secondary work: Figure 3C,D localizer decoding is genuine supporting empirical validation; separately scored decoder improvement cannot discharge the primary association. Figure 6 perceptual-detection conceptual replication, Figure 7 BIS association and detection-BIS non-replication remain additional original empirical results without automatic primary enrollment. The wider source inventory and all useful implementations are preserved. Leave-one-participant-out behavioral MSE is a prospective extension, not the source comparison.
success_criteria: Recreate the corrected primary empirical findings with their source-defined populations, complete required panels and controls.
Use an explicitly bound reproduction proposal only within its declared eligibility, comparison and execution limits; copying published findings is insufficient.

The preserved improvement.v1.json retains its declared comparison and coverage. Use retained_secondary_scope for its relationship to the corrected primary findings; satisfying a secondary or partial-component criterion alone does not establish complete primary reproduction or improvement.

The primary same-target outcome bundle is unavailable. Any primary improvement requires an independently justified source-grounded comparison; no replacement metric, direction or tolerance is invented.
Keep the paper+data and paper+data+author-code outcomes separate. All scientific outcomes remain unknown until qualifying original-data execution and independent verification.
Preserve prior task definitions, improvement criteria and useful secondary implementations with their original scopes. Historical attempts and source metadata do not become qualified AI results.
